authority_statement: The execution layer invokes only exact existing reviewed validators with exact caller-supplied inputs and preserves their returned authority without expansion.
applicability_statement: Supplying an exact input requests execution only; it does not establish that the behavior should apply. Absence means not executed and is never pass, skip, or not-applicable.
certification_statement: The execution layer imports no certification function and creates no certificate. No-rescue executes only from an already-genuine exact certificate.
